name: A Simple Question
source:
A young couple find themselves at a strange crossroads of their relationship and are forced to confront a simple yet difficult question together.

[From [url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/asimplequestion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一對年輕戀人走到了感情中一個意想不到的岔路口，不得不一起面對一個問起來簡單、答起來卻很難的問題。

［摘自[url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/asimplequestion]itch.io[/url]］
